assumptions.statement: The submitted SITE_BOUNDARY is the maintainer-defined provisional polygon derived from public announcement text and approximate area, not an official planning redline.
assumptions.impact: All spatial metrics and figures are intake-grade design evidence; replace the polygon and recalculate every dependent layer when an official or cleared file arrives.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Official CAD/GIS/PDF boundary with source, version, CRS, and conversion record.

assumptions.statement: The three KEY_AREA rectangles preserve announced order and approximate area only; they are not station-anchored, parcel boundaries, or road interfaces.
assumptions.impact: Key-area design is a scale-free reference scheme and must be re-anchored after official polygons arrive.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Official key-area polygons and a checked site anchor inventory.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, building density, setbacks, four-line controls, fire, and municipal conditions are not in the cleared package.
assumptions.impact: No statutory intensity, height, demolition, construction, or engineering conclusion is made.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Approved regulatory detailed planning conditions and relevant official attachments.
assumptions.human_owner: Licensed planning, architecture and municipal teams

assumptions.statement: Building footprints are low-confidence conceptual interfaces generated inside the provisional site; there is no parcel, ownership, floor count, or existing-building survey.
assumptions.impact: Retain-renovate-demolish labels are prompts for field verification, not decisions about a property.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Cleared building survey, parcel/ownership record, and public consultation.
assumptions.human_owner: Property holders and professional design team

assumptions.statement: Road and rail lines are conceptual walking/cycling relationships clipped to the provisional site; they do not show redlines, station positions, bridge works, or construction feasibility.
assumptions.impact: Mobility proposals stay scale-free until a transport study and accessible-route audit are complete.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Official transport, rail, road-redline, cross-section and accessibility data.

assumptions.statement: The proposal uses the publicly named Jing-Zhang Railway Heritage Park and historical narrative as context, while exact heritage protection and green-line controls remain unverified.
assumptions.impact: Interpretation and public-space components are reversible, low-intrusion concepts with curator review gates.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Official heritage inventory, protection plan and park implementation boundary.

assumptions.statement: Utilities, drainage, flood, fire, energy and waste capacity are not available in the public package.
assumptions.impact: The proposal names service questions and operating checks but does not claim capacity or engineering feasibility.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Official municipal and safety baseline plus site walkover.
assumptions.human_owner: Municipal, fire, ecology and operations teams

assumptions.statement: Outcome metrics for accessibility, shade, seating, heat, rain, safety, maintenance and resident experience require a field baseline; geometry-derived ratios are not outcome claims.
assumptions.impact: Every trial has a no-go gate, a human fallback, and a retest requirement before expansion.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Seasonal field audit with resident and accessibility participation.

assumptions.statement: Roles, service windows, event calendar, and funding pathways are reference operating models, not government commitments.
assumptions.impact: A named responsible organization, resource envelope, public notice and stop condition are required before any trial.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Responsible-party confirmation, budget/resource check and public review.

assumptions.statement: Figures, diagrams, HTML and PDFs are generated locally from package geometry and original text; no external image, map tile, logo or font file is redistributed.
assumptions.impact: Case studies remain background references and are not copied as assets.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Rights review if any external visual or font asset is added.
